title.zh: Copilot Studio 自举式软件工厂：智能体、自动化与人机协同闭环（LIVE149）
title.en: Copilot Studio Self-Hosting Software Factory: Agent Fleet & Human-in-the-Loop Architecture (LIVE149)

label.zh: 1. 全天候感知与反馈采集层（Telemetry, User Signals & Direct Prototyping）
label.en: 1. Continuous Sensing & Prototyping Plane (Telemetry, Social Feedback & Design)

label.zh: 2. 智能体软件工厂执行层（Dozens of Specialized Agents Running on Copilot Studio）
label.en: 2. Agentic Software Factory Plane (Dozens of Role-Scoped Agents on Copilot Studio)

label.zh: 3. 人机门禁合入与生产环外溢层（Human-in-the-Loop Merge & Work OS Platform）
label.en: 3. Governed Merge, Early-Ring Hardening & Customer Work OS Plane

label.zh: 生产遥测与运行监控流

detail.zh: 实时捕捉线上报错、工具调用瓶颈与早期测试环运行信号
detail.en: Captures live runtime signals, workflow bottlenecks, and early-ring metrics

label.zh: 外部用户反馈与录屏动态

detail.zh: 倾听社区与 LinkedIn 详细复现视频，让真实用户直接触发改进循环
detail.en: Ingests detailed user posts and screen recordings as actionable bug triggers

label.zh: 跨职能角色直接提交 PR（>50% 设计师）

detail.zh: 告别数周焦点小组与静态稿排期，设计师直接动手实现可运行原型
detail.en: Skips weeks of flat-file specs; over half of designers submit code PRs

label.zh: 夜间复现与问题核验智能体

detail.zh: 当晚自动拾取外部痛点报告，独立核查并确认缺陷真实可复现
detail.en: Picks up incoming reports overnight to verify and reproduce real product gaps

label.zh: 代码修复与特性构建智能体

detail.zh: 打破“写代码最慢最难”旧假设，自动编写补丁与新功能实现分支
detail.en: Eliminates manual coding bottlenecks by authoring fixes and feature branches

label.zh: 自动化验证与双倍覆盖测试流

detail.zh: 用智能体与确定性自动化流检验补丁，朝预算减半且覆盖翻倍演进
detail.en: Validates candidate PRs continuously toward lower test cost and 2x coverage

label.zh: 人在回路晨间合入（24h 闭环回访）

detail.zh: 工程师把关架构与合入红线，次晨合并并在 24 小时内通知用户补丁在途
detail.en: Engineers review and merge in the morning, closing the user loop in 24 hours

label.zh: 早期用户环试穿与生产加固

detail.zh: 先内部上手感受再推送早期用户环实测，筛选高价值能力加固推向主干
detail.en: Tests live in early user rings before hardening proven features for GA

label.zh: 工作操作系统外溢（Markel 等客户）

detail.zh: 将同源底座赋能财务、政务与航运承保（18h 窗口内决策提速 3 倍+）
detail.en: Exports the same platform to finance, gov, and Markel marine (<18h, 3x+ speed)
